<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917741_theRebbe_999" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917741_theRebbe_999__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The superiority of the arousal from above is that it draws from a place beyond the reach of arousal from below, stemming from His desire for kindness, and the root of Israel's service is in the essential thought above even this desire, so that when the arousal from above is elicited through human service, it is elevated by the essential thought.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">The explanation of the matter is,</t>
    <t s="2">that the superiority in the arousal from above</t>
    <t s="3">(which is from its own side)</t>
    <t s="4">is that the drawing forth is from a place that arousal from below does not reach there,</t>
    <t s="5">and the drawing forth is because</t>
    <t s="6">"He desires kindness".</t>
    <t s="7">And according to the known</t>
    <t s="8">matter of "Whom did He consult? The souls of the righteous"</t>
    <t s="9">("and Your people are all righteous"),</t>
    <t s="10">that this—that He is aroused, as it were, to desire kindness—is from the aspect that arose in thought</t>
    <t s="11">(essential thought,</t>
    <t s="12">which is above the revelation of the desire for kindness)</t>
    <t s="13">that in the future Israel will fulfill Torah and mitzvos and make a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="14">It is understood,</t>
    <t s="15">that the root of the service of Israel is higher even than the matter of the desire for kindness.</t>
    <t s="16">And through the revelation of the desire for kindness being aroused and drawn forth by means of man's service,</t>
    <t s="17">there is added to it a more elevated superiority</t>
    <t s="18">(than as it is from its own side,</t>
    <t s="19">from the aspect of above),</t>
    <t s="20">for there is drawn into it from the essential thought that is above revelation.</t>
    <t s="21">And based on this, we can explain,</t>
    <t s="22">that this—that in the month of Nissan</t>
    <t s="23">(whose matter is a drawing forth from above)</t>
    <t s="24">we read "When a woman conceives and gives birth to a male"</t>
    <t s="25">(the emphasis on the superiority of arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="26">is,</t>
    <t s="27">because the primary elevation in the drawing forth from above</t>
    <t s="28">(and the revelation of the desire for kindness)</t>
    <t s="29">is when it is drawn forth through service.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This matter—that the woman conceiving first gives birth to a male—indicates the superiority of arousal from below, whether as a cause for a higher arousal from above or as having inherent superiority, and the order of the two interpretations hints that initial service elevates the arousal from above, which then reveals the inherent superiority of arousal from below itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this matter</t>
    <t s="2">(that a woman conceiving first gives birth to a male indicates the superiority in arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="3">is also according to the interpretation that the birth of a male is from the drop of the male that comes last, for "the upper one prevails".</t>
    <t s="4">However, according to this interpretation,</t>
    <t s="5">the superiority in arousal from below</t>
    <t s="6">(the woman's seed)</t>
    <t s="7">is that it causes the arousal from above drawn forth through it to be from a more elevated level</t>
    <t s="8">("the upper one prevails"),</t>
    <t s="9">and according to the interpretation that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed,</t>
    <t s="10">the superiority in arousal from below is</t>
    <t s="11">(also)</t>
    <t s="12">from its own side.</t>
    <t s="13">And based on this, we can say the hint in the order of the two interpretations,</t>
    <t s="14">that it precedes the interpretation that the birth of a male is from the male's seed,</t>
    <t s="15">even though the conclusion is that it is from the woman's seed,</t>
    <t s="16">because at the beginning of service,</t>
    <t s="17">the superiority of arousal from below is that the arousal from above drawn forth through it is more elevated,</t>
    <t s="18">and through this, the superiority in arousal from below itself is later revealed.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>There is a third level of arousal from above, as a gift, which requires the completion of human service to be revealed; although arousal from below only reaches the light related to worlds, the essential power within Israel's service—rooted in God's essential thought—draws forth even the light beyond relation to worlds, up to the drawing of Atzmus itself, after the service is complete and its inner delight is revealed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this will be understood according to what is explained in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="1">that there is a third level in arousal from above,</t>
    <t s="2">which is in the manner of a gift.</t>
    <t s="3">For even this arousal from above is drawn from a place that arousal from below does not reach there at all,</t>
    <t s="4">but in order for the revelation of this arousal from above to occur, there must first be the completion of the actions of the lower beings,</t>
    <t s="5">the arousal from below and the arousal from above drawn forth through it.</t>
    <t s="6">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="7">behold, the intent that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="8">is that the making of the dwelling place should be through man's service,</t>
    <t s="9">from which it is understood,</t>
    <t s="10">that even the most elevated revelations,</t>
    <t s="11">even the light that is above relation to created beings</t>
    <t s="12">(where the power of arousal from below cannot reach),</t>
    <t s="13">and even up to the revelation of Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="14">are drawn forth through man's service.</t>
    <t s="15">And how does this align with what was brought above from Likkutei Torah, that through service only that level is drawn where arousal from below reaches,</t>
    <t s="16">and the drawing of the levels above that is in the manner of a gift from above?</t>
    <t s="17">And we can say the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="18">that this—that arousal from below reaches only the light related to worlds—is from the aspect of the nature of created beings</t>
    <t s="19">[arousal from below as it is in the level of "lower",</t>
    <t s="20">which is separate from "upper"].</t>
    <t s="21">But from the aspect of the power of Atzmus that exists in the service of Israel</t>
    <t s="22">[and as was explained above</t>
    <t s="23">(section 3)</t>
    <t s="24">regarding the matter of "Whom did He consult? The souls of the righteous",</t>
    <t s="25">that the root of the service of Israel is in the essential thought in His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="26">which is above all revelations,</t>
    <t s="27">even the most elevated revelations],</t>
    <t s="28">there is no room to distinguish between "lower" and "upper",</t>
    <t s="29">for Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He, are entirely one.</t>
    <t s="30">However, the revelation of this matter</t>
    <t s="31">(the root of the service of Israel as it is in the essential thought)</t>
    <t s="32">is specifically after all that pertains to man's service is completed,</t>
    <t s="33">the service itself</t>
    <t s="34">(arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="35">and the drawing forth from above</t>
    <t s="36">(arousal from above)</t>
    <t s="37">that comes through it.</t>
    <t s="38">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="39">the beginning of the drawing forth that comes through service</t>
    <t s="40">(before the power of Atzmus within it is revealed)</t>
    <t s="41">is only from the light related to worlds,</t>
    <t s="42">the place that arousal from below reaches,</t>
    <t s="43">but after the completion of service</t>
    <t s="44">(both the service itself and the drawing forth from above through it),</t>
    <t s="45">when its "innerness" is then revealed,</t>
    <t s="46">the gratification and delight that are above in the service of Israel,</t>
    <t s="47">"Gratification before Me that I spoke and My will was done",</t>
    <t s="48">for this gratification and delight</t>
    <t s="49">("My will was done",</t>
    <t s="50">by Israel)</t>
    <t s="51">is in His very Essence</t>
    <t s="52">("Gratification before Me"),</t>
    <t s="53">through service there is also drawn the light that is above relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="54">and even up to the drawing of Atzmus.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
